title: Block Oscillator Factorization
body_html:
Block Oscillator Factorization

For the block decomposition \(W=\boxplus W\oplus\boxminus W\), the finite oscillator representation and the stabilizer action factor as \[ \omega_w=\omega_{\boxplus S}\otimes \omega_{\boxminus}. \] The off-diagonal factor \(\omega_{\boxminus}\) is isomorphic to the off-diagonal Heisenberg-Weil factor \(\kappa_{\boxminus}\).
proof_html: This follows by combining the off-diagonal kappa-oscillator identification supercuspidal_theta.off_diagonal_kappa_oscillator_identification with the block oscillator action factorization supercuspidal_theta.block_oscillator_action_factorization. The former identifies the off-diagonal oscillator action with the off-diagonal Yu \(\kappa\)-factor, and the latter factors the translated orbit representation into its block-diagonal and off-diagonal tensor factors.
